caveat: Single run over 30 answerable cases; multihop is 10 of them, so +36.7pp is about eight gold documents. Direction and magnitude are clear, the exact value is not. This measures retrieval only — whether reranking improves final answers depends on the grader, synthesis and citation gate downstream, which only the ablation shows.
cpu_note: CPU reranking is not viable: 30 cases had not finished after 10 minutes.
